environment.description: Same Kubernetes deployment but feature flags are evaluated via Split.io SDK with server-side targeting rules. The workspace has a kill switch definition where the flag 'use_legacy_http_proxy' is configured with a default treatment of 'off' for the targeting rule matching the service key 'stream-processor-*'. The flag definition was updated 2024-01-15 and the SDK polling interval is 30s. The init() function in production reads from the Split SDK rather than hardcoded values. Note: the 'enable_chunked_forwarding' flag remains 'on' in Split but is only evaluated inside the legacyForward code path which is unreachable when use_legacy_http_proxy is off. The modernForward path uses Go's net/http client which properly handles header construction and prevents smuggling.

feature_flags.provider: Split.io cloud SDK, API key scoped to production environment

enable_chunked_forwarding.note: only evaluated within legacyForward which is gated by use_legacy_http_proxy

config.network: flat pod network, no service mesh
